annotator: Claude (Anthropic model), single pass over human_validation_100_cases.xlsx only (blind: no key, no model or LLM labels seen while labelling)

post_hoc_comparison_with_pilot_llm_label.note: computed AFTER the labels were fixed, using the id->item key

caveats: NOT human validation. These labels must never be reported as human labels or merged into human_labels.jsonl.
Not independent of the pilot Claude annotator: same model family, so the high agreement with it is expected and is not evidence of correctness.
The reserved 100 are Spider items dominated by 'table' (73 of 100); class balance is poor, so metrics on them are weak for chart classes other than table and kpi.
Eight disagreements with the pilot Codex annotator (H018, H023, H059, H060, H063, H075, H078, H098) are judgement calls about kpi vs table and bar vs horizontal_bar.
